source: client configs.ab dorm_furniture · dorm_fnt_category · dorm_theme · item (2026-11-05)

themes.name: Nightmare Grotto
themes.info: The night lifts its veil, and nightmares soon follow in its wake.

themes.name: Seaside Vacation
themes.info: We follow the smell of the sea in search of a new adventure, and when we look back after getting tired, the lighthouse is there to guide us home.

themes.name: LOFT
themes.info: Artists seek a minimalist beauty in poverty, and the wealthy learned about it. Thus both began seeking decadence in simplicity.

themes.name: Winter Days
themes.info: "The second best thing in life is having somewhere to go on a cold, snowy night. The best thing in life is having someone there waiting for you to return."

themes.name: BPT2 Living Room
themes.info: "Let go of all sensation and allow yourself to dissolve into the quiet night."

themes.name: New Year's Vigil
themes.info: Having such a large home is a blessing, and having enough stories to fill that home up is a blessing for several generations."

themes.name: Magrasea Classroom
themes.info: What's this learning thing? Is it when humans gather in a classroom to eat Memory Bread ~nya? — Betty

themes.name: Starry Night Dreams
themes.info: "As night falls, I will weave you a wonderful dream with stars and love."

themes.name: Fairground
themes.info: Happiness has never been simpler than having a carnival's climax take place in an amusement park. Note: please don't bring your leftover work in here.

themes.name: Photography Studio
themes.info: The facilities here are all of a professional grade and the staff here have all been trained to not laugh regardless of what they see through the camera lens. Unless, of course, it really IS that funny.

themes.name: Music Festival
themes.info: What do we say to keeping pitch-perfect with stuffy old pieces? Not today! Sing to your heart's content as you rock around the clock tonight!

themes.name: 42Lab
themes.info: The shiny glass panels, mechanical arms and control terminals that you see show that this is not a room for resting, but a greenhouse for the truth.

themes.name: Rossum Sector
themes.info: The fruits of wisdom grow in silence.

themes.name: Burbank Arcade
themes.info: This is the Burbank arcade, a high-end entertainment facility in Magrasea's biggest entertainment capital. It's not about mere replication, but instead, a relentless pursuit of perfection.

themes.name: Spooky Castle Night
themes.info: Everyone who was drawn to this place by its atmosphere wants to spend an unforgettable night here... But after that, nobody found any trace of them, so maybe that's what happened.

themes.name: Warm Soiree
themes.info: When the night draws near, will there be someone who will carve out a little niche for you with a light, where you can freely speak what's on your mind?

themes.name: Crystal Night
themes.info: Let's open our gifts in front of the snowy window! The translucent crystal is so lovely and clear, shining like our feelings of anticipation.

themes.name: Spring Lantern Courtyard
themes.info: A lively little courtyard filled with joy. Perhaps the real reunion is found in the heart, far from the bustling lanterns.

themes.name: Verdant Rebirth
themes.info: After a terrible disaster, the verdancy of life springs eternal in the footsteps of where we've been.

themes.name: Scintillating Shoal
themes.info: Seemingly peaceful shallows with a churning undertow, the lair of a sparkling shoal.

themes.name: Lingering Dawnlight
themes.info: After awakening from a long dream, the light of dawn gently fills this place. The dust of ages has settled, and as the memories wash over you, you realize that you once bore witness to a fall and rebirth.

themes.name: Lively Night Market
themes.info: The city at night is always filled with people coming and going, and the smell of food conceals many interwoven stories. This is the sense of life that can only be found in the busy city.

themes.name: Deep Space Vigil
themes.info: After shedding their redundant equipment, the explorers of space set foot here.

themes.name: Galactic Voyage
themes.info: Slumber amidst the stars, awake amidst the cosmos, travelling on a long, silent journey.

themes.name: Future Gadgets Lab
themes.info: This place looks a little run-down, but that is merely a disguise. Its true identity is a secret lab created by an organization that intends to upset the order of the world... I guess?

themes.name: Lone Star's Temple
themes.info: An exact crafted replica of the Reverse Babylon Tower's inner layout, a holy sanctuary that once embodied the greatest of authorities. You stand here for some time after the trials you have faced, as if listening to the countless stories it has to tell. Some you've heard before, and some you have not.

items.name: Wall
items.desc: Magrasea's basic wall design. Simple but sturdy.

items.name: Faded Wallpaper
items.desc: Wallpaper designed with a vintage look, recording the passing time on the Cloud server.

items.name: Classroom Wallpaper
items.desc: The difference between an uncultured student or a bold hero lies entirely in whether or not your coming actions can make the shoeprints you left on the wall irrelevant.

items.name: Dark Gray Wall
items.desc: Things that make people fall quiet also tends to be depressing. In that regard, a dark-colored wall is the same as the nigth sky.

items.name: White Wall Tiles
items.desc: Many lofts were originally workshops, and the white ceramic tiles that were retained have a unique charm of their own.

items.name: Sugar Wallpaper - Lovely Pink
items.desc: This wallpaper design should make you feel happy and relaxed, but only if you were not bullied in kindergarten.

items.name: Starry Wallpaper
items.desc: This wallpaper with color of the night sky is dotted with dark gold stars, making it look as if you are lying in a starry sky while gazing into the history.

items.name: Tidal wallpaper
items.desc: The illusion of a beach is created with holographic projection, plus some tidal sound effects as white noise to help you fall sleep—it's all fun and games unless you're thalassaphobic.

items.name: Mysterious Blockade
items.desc: A floor designed after the underground cave in Copley Sector. The tunnels are blocked with a hardened mix of Entropy Liquid and dust. The truth is so far away.

items.name: Waterproof Tile Wall
items.desc: An orderly ceramic tile wall. Even thought the Agent that built it didn't understand how fireproofing programs could be used to make waterproof tiles, she still produced her work on time.

items.name: Porcelain Chocolate Tiles
items.desc: These delicious-looking tiles won't melt because of the warm weather. Though they are a clean and pure white color, they bring a sweet sense of delight.
items.source: Obtained from the event "Heartfelt House of Cocoa".

items.name: Sparkling Night
items.desc: Shatter your longings with fireworks and fill them with summer nights that are nearing their end.
items.source: Obtained through the "Wishing Starbridge Workshop" event

items.name: Winter Wallpaper
items.desc: "You see that mistletoe hanging over there? That person is waiting for you..."

items.name: Man-made Textured Stone Wall
items.desc: A wall so black that it could blend in with the night, as though you were walking on a lightless place. For those who need protection, the all-concealing darkness always puts their hearts at ease.

items.name: Siheyuan Walls
items.desc: When you learn to sit quietly in the yard and watch the snow fall with your family, do you not sometimes fantasize about the scenes beyond these walls?

items.name: Full Moon And The Sea Story Circle
items.desc: At the very end, the storyteller and the story's characters meet again, and the moon goes to sleep in satisfaction.

items.name: Halcyon Fairgrounds
items.desc: "The Festival's about to begin, why are you still here? Quick, look towards that clear and azure sky, and see yourself flying towards that beautiful Xanadu!"

items.name: Grey Brick Wall
items.desc: The old-timey bricks bring you back to the metropolises of last century. Even if there are no little spiders jumping around here, heroes will always be born.

items.name: Stage Background
items.desc: See that? That's us with another crowd, seeking our own selves.

items.name: Soundproofed Lab Walls
items.desc: The walls have biological sensors built into them, and they trigger an alarm if the personnel within do not move for more than 10 minutes. This is why you can't take afternoon naps here.

items.name: Serene Greywall
items.desc:
Why do research institutes like painting their walls gray, white or black, and not other colors?
"I mean, aren't ALL walls usually gray, white or black?"

items.name: Arcade Wall
items.desc: The entertainment here spans to gaming lounges, heaven and hell... You're getting close to the boundaries of entertainment, and it's time to turn back.

items.name: Eerie Stone Walls
items.desc: Preservation is the best way to commit to memory. Hold onto these precious histories, even if you might get a bout of rheumatism if you live here... not a price one cannot pay, right?

items.name: Velvet Wallpaper
items.desc: Whether we're drunk or tired, we're never jolted back to lucidity when we place our hands on the wall to support ourselves as we wander freely, half-awake and half-dreaming as we dip in and out of consciousness. This is the kindness we ought to reserve for ourselves.

items.name: Snowflake Wallpaper
items.desc: The wood-print snowflakes feel like you're inviting winter into your house. As the chill fades away, lean back to back against each other, sleeping together, dreaming together.

items.name: Sky Lantern Street
items.desc: Under the cover of night, the sky lanterns float in the air like stars along this long road. I'm sure one of them was set aloft for you. Ahhhhhh look out! It's on fire!

items.name: Speckled Verdancy
items.desc: New vegetation has sprouted from the cracks in the wall. Logically speaking, this sort of thing should not happen in the Oasis, but converting loose operands into scattered vegetation might be a unique trait of the Oasis.

items.name: Littoral School
items.desc: The points of light swimming in the ocean reflect their silent surroundings. This wallpaper was originally designed to be static, but the jellyfish in the background and the position of the bubbles make them look like they're moving.

items.name: Gentle White Wallpaper
items.desc: The faint tracery matches well with the white undercolor, creating a serene atmosphere. Reality wouldn't be so bad if you could wake up to it in surroundings like these.

items.name: Roller Shutter Wall
items.desc: When the shutters are lowered and the lights are turned on, this place becomes a neat series of walls. You can strike all kinds of poses underneath their illumination, but beware of angry shopkeepers chasing you away.

items.name: Space Bulkhead
items.desc: A space station's gravity systems are always working, and under normal circumstances you shouldn't need to use the wall as a floor. Of course, accidents do happen, and if they do, this bulkhead can fulfil its calling as backup flooring.

items.name: Infinite Nebulae
items.desc: Nebulae are pretty and filled with endless fantasy. But however inviting these balls of light are to touch, please remember that they are nothing more than unchanging wall panels.

items.name: Wind God's Barrier
items.desc: Although it's got quite a chuuni name, it's fundamentally a very ordinary wall, which helps the inhabitants ward off chill winds.

items.name: Flawless Divider
items.desc: Face a perfect white wall, and enter an ocean of thoughts. Transform into an infinitely white light, an eternal sea, a boundless swathe of bubbles.

items.name: Sealed Paper Window
items.desc: To meet everyone's demand for more windows, Croque has put together a fake one with Operand. Be careful when moving it around. There's not many other options as we don't have enough Prefabricated Units now. We'll have to make do with what we have for now!

items.name: Bent Needle Clock
items.desc: No, this isn't one of Salvador Dali's works, someone just bent its hands as a prank.

items.name: Exhaust Fans
items.desc: The exhaust fan ensures proper ventilation, and provides atmospheric background noise when it gets too quiet in the room.

items.name: Beverage Rack
items.desc: Persicaria has been encouraging people to put their favorite drinks on the shelves, and now a huge variety of them have been collected. The most popular ones are still Persicaria's coffee, coffee, and more coffee.

items.name: Camera
items.desc: Legend has it that the electronic sheep can be caught on camera, but aren't the cameras made of Operand like us?

items.name: TapTap Neon Lights
items.desc: A neon light designed after the logo of a famous game appstore. Its packaging has a disclaimer warning printed on top: "Please do not play games in a room where only the neon light is on. You may receive warnings from your vision module."

items.name: Scattered Bookshelf
items.desc: A couple random books are placed on this wall hanging bookshelf, in an attempt to pretend the owner is a book person.

items.name: Ocean View Window
items.desc: High-definition video of real seascape. Have some fruits while you watch it to enjoy a dreamy experience that feels almost as if you're back in the real world.

items.name: Ebony Window Frame
items.desc: It's always relaxing to get a view of the outside world, even if it stays the same every day. Being able to see represents the freedom of choice in itself, even if we have nothing else beside that.

items.name: Whitewood Window Frame
items.desc: A cozy whitewood window frame, available at an affordable price. Windows are pointless without a window pane wide enough to host a cute little animal!

items.name: Wooden Window Frame
items.desc: An elegant wooden window frame, available at an affordable price. Windows are pointless without a window pane wide enough to host a cute little animal!

items.name: Exquisite Bay Window
items.desc: A nicely built bay window with plenty space. You can comfortably enjoy the view outside with your cat here. Loneliness does not dissipate when you are accompanied by someone else, but the companionship does mellow it into something sweeter.

items.name: Lighthouse Sticker
items.desc: People always build lighthouses on the sea. When you are lost in the ocean's vastness, the light will guide you back to safety—even if this lighthouse is only a sticker on the wall.

items.name: Floating Plankton
items.desc: Stickers designed after the look of floating entropy. The earliest living beings once floated in the sea like this, waiting for the time of evolution to arrive.

items.name: Hanging Poster
items.desc: "Which do you trust more, between Lord Eosphorus in the distant Reverse Tower or Baalia who's by your side?"

items.name: Hanging Map
items.desc: This is a familiar-looking map. Will it bring nostalgia, regret, or perhaps a certain conviction?

items.name: Real Wood Wall Lamp
items.desc: "Why did you hang a piece of wood on the walls?" When you voice the doubts in your heart, you are no longer an artist.

items.name: Autumn Window Wall
items.desc: "Attention all Exiles: Oasis' windows are not electronic screens, please do not change in front of them."

items.name: Classroom Corkboard
items.desc: Duty rosters, class schedules, as well as various notices... There's so much written here, but Simo and Sueyoi still miss it very easily!

items.name: Classroom Shelf
items.desc: You should not take pride in joining a group, but make the group consider your joining them to be an honor.

items.name: Classroom Loudspeaker
items.desc: A loudspeaker installed inside the classroom, which can be used for playing announcements, radio channels, and Anri Okita videos... Yes, after that last one, only the Professor was allowed to turn the speaker on.

items.name: Classroom Blackboard
items.desc: During the great struggle to become class rep, Betty promised to buy a can of cat food for everyone, Kuro promised that everyone could skip class... In the end, the competition ended up going nowhere because Persicaria woke up, and only the blackboard remembers the proceedings.

items.name: Classroom Window
items.desc: Someday, we will enter that world we so admired, and then we will suddenly look back... Life is an endless series of missed opportunities, isn't it?

items.name: Countdown Banner
items.desc: Though it was originally designed to help everyone feel the tension before an exam, in the end it was only the Professor that was hurt.

items.name: Shower Head
items.desc: "The Professor uses simple-structure operand to wash themselves.  This is a special ritual in the real world. Humans believe that this will simplify and clarify their own programming." - [The Oasis Natives On Reality]

items.name: Towel Rack
items.desc: A rack for towels and other miscellaneous items, commonly used with the sink. It's structure is too simple, which means there are no ghost stories circulating about it.

items.name: ME78's Shield
items.desc: A shield that comes with ME78. It can be used as a wall-hanging decoration, but watch out for it turning back into a machine soldier again at nights.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: "Eucharist's Arms"
items.desc: "Who doesn't like weapons that also double as eating utensils?"

items.name: "Mark of the Saint"
items.desc: "Slacking off is a form of resistance to excessive pressure from one's superiors, so Eucharist only uses the shield she was assigned by the system as target practice."

items.name: "Weekly Timekeeper"
items.desc: Timeliness is a virtue, but it is a character detail that Dolls must religiously adhere to. That's probably sneakiness on their creators' part.

items.name: H-01's Hat
items.desc: A hat that comes for free with the H-01 Doll. Supposedly, anyone who puts it on will be left at Antonina's mercy. It can be used as a wall decoration, mainly because you can't do anything else with it since access to it has been completely sealed off.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: C2E2's Bookshelf
items.desc: A rack and stereoscopic picture book that came along with C2E2, recording a few universally known fairy tales. Aside from chiding children to sleep, it can also be used as comparison material for making paper lamps with those near and dear to you.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Bodyguard SP's Daisho Set
items.desc: A daisho set that comes free with the Bodyguard SP, specially designed for twin sword wielders. Their sharp blades allow them to easily pierce tank armor, as well as the scarred ceiling of the training hall.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: UL-VET Workboard
items.desc: A workboard gifted with the UL-VET Model, sturdy and durable, easy to clean. The attached magnets can be used for displaying as many documents and photos as is physically possible: various animals, medical documents, and that certain someone she finds interesting.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: RP VII's Arsenal
items.desc: A gun case that comes for free with the RP VII. Its contents are divided into training and live weapons. If you want to borrow something for an exercise, you need to get its owner's permission, lest holes get blasted into the dorm tables because someone mixed up the two...
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Brocaded Fan
items.desc: An ornamental fan that comes with the CM-ENT 2.0A. Its ribs are ebony and it is adorned with gold patterns, exquisite in every detail, concealing crimson lips, snow-white fingers and sable hair behind its folds... suitable for enjoyment with one of like heart.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: A-PST(Di)'s Astrolabe
items.desc: An astrolabe that comes with the A-PST(Di). Supposedly, it has mystical abilities of prediction. Please turn it gently when using it; it has been dropped countless times already.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Nascita's Mask
items.desc: A mask Nascita once used in her shows. It's styled to resemble how an archvillain should look, and it has borne witness to many of Nascita's exciting performances. Much as she would like to play a hero of justice, she'll still play the role of the bad guy with all her might— Huh? Why is she straying further and further from the path of a proper villain...
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Zangyin's Cultural Artifacts
items.desc: Zangyin's collection of anthropological artifacts. Her endless love for folklore and her quirky personality have given her a unique attachment to these interesting little devices. Of course, some of them are a little unusual... or should we say, "unnatural"?
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Croque's Defense Line
items.desc: A makeshift door shield. With Croque's protection, even the patchwork of warning stripes and scavenged door panels would become an impregnable defense line that cannot be crossed.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Souchun's Verdant Shield
items.desc: Souchun's signature defensive implement, also usable as a decorative wall hanging. It uniquely combines biological and mechanical elements. Best not to touch it carelessly, lest misfortune befall you.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Christmas Fireplace
items.desc: A cold winter night, a warm room, and a mistletoe wreath hung up above the hearth. What else is there keeping you from meeting the people important to you and spending the night with them?

items.name: Winter Landscape Window
items.desc: "Now until forever, now until forever, I wish to sing by your side, dance with the flowers, and soar with the birds."

items.name: Lonely Night Street View
items.desc: Of all the cars that come and go, none of them are connected to you. The same goes for the lights outside. --Is this happiness or misfortune for you?

items.name: Siheyuan Window
items.desc: Back then, we used clothes to block off the windows, our mattresses to cover up our manga, and fought to protect our little hobbies. Did you succeed, no-longer-youthful warrior?

items.name: Big Red Lantern
items.desc: Croque made this lantern to your specifications, to the point where it doesn't even melt the snow that falls on it. The candle flame that flickered within it during your youth will never return, so when can you return to reality again?

items.name: Light-Filled Glass Lamp
items.desc: With a glass of tea made from night-filled light, please stay here and talk with me until daybreak tomorrow.

items.name: Unicorn
items.desc: When you really need it, it doesn't matter if it has a horn or not.

items.name: Nightview Window
items.desc: "Lost in the hot waves of the pink-purple neon lights, as if we were in the very City of Sin, along the discos in the night and the shaking palm trees... this can only mean one thing!" "What?" "Someone's a big fan of the 80s' vibe in the workshops."

items.name: Stage Lights
items.desc: For the angels in the light to be beloved by all, we must abide darkness.

items.name: Super-sized Panoramic Curtain Wall
items.desc: In your lifetime, you might not see the truth spread as far and wide as the view this curtain wall offers.

items.name: Brown French Window
items.desc: The servers are on the other side of the window. A single pane of glass or a login screen are enough to separate you from the cloud server.

items.name: Wall Pipe Set
items.desc: Responsible for delivering coolant to every region of the control center. Its design is old and simple, but practical.

items.name: Arcade Wall-Mounted Light (Blue)
items.desc: Lighting placed in the Arcade, simple yet thought-provoking. Unfortunately, those with the time to stop and think are far and few between.

items.name: Arcade Wall-Mounted Light (Pink)
items.desc: Lighting placed in the Arcade, simple yet thought-provoking. A man stood in this place, thought, and asked" Why are there three capsules here?"

items.name: Shadows of Days Past
items.desc: Trust not the mirror, for it is far too honest... Yes, exactly so.

items.name: Figures of Glory
items.desc: The glories of yesterday make their way off the banners, wrapping themselves around warriors' throats.

items.name: Blue Fireplace
items.desc: The bodies of your companions burn, but there'll be no warmth to be found here. Go onwards.

items.name: Nightstain Window
items.desc: Stare not into the windows for too long. You should know—when lightning passes, windows can also serve as mirrors...

items.name: Leafy Green Lights
items.desc:
Some decorations have no particular significance. They exist simply for the sake of a party, and when all's said and done, it is the only sign that there was activity and life in this place.
"This is farewell, but we'd rather look forward to the next wild journey under the blue skies."

items.name: Winter Harbor
items.desc: If there was anything more romantic than curling up in a warm house and enjoying the night scenery on a winter day, it would be doing it with friends — we even bet on which icicle on the door would fall first.

items.name: Reindeer Hat
items.desc: I believe that Santa Claus exists, as well as those two reindeer which bear gifts. That's why I always look forward to winter.

items.name: Winter Fireplace
items.desc: Have two cups of tea ready by the fireplace, so we can open the gifts from far away and listen to stories from our journey.

items.name: Snowflake Wall Hanging
items.desc: The laughter as you ring these bells will echo in my ears for many a winter night.

items.name: Starry Snow Wall Hanging
items.desc: Let's cut the feathers of winter into beautiful, starry flowers and stick them on a wall.

items.name: Wishing Star Pinup
items.desc: Let's leave a picture behind to commemorate this warm night.

items.name: Snowy Picture Window
items.desc: The gods have blessed the world outside with an immaculate snowfall to cleanse it, and this window shows all kinds of scenes from it.

items.name: Wishing Sky Lantern
items.desc: What wishes do these slowly-ascending lanterns hold? For a good harvest, a smooth road ahead, or the name of someone that you long to see — Huh, someone actually wished for a certain person to submit their work, I guess that's the Oasis' most famous scriptwriter for you!

items.name: Gazing Into The Distance
items.desc: The distant scenery visible through these floor-to-ceiling windows is still wreathed in the clouds of dust left behind by the disaster. While what you can see is no longer pockmarked by scars, there's still a veritable mountain of things that have to be done before this place can truly be considered rebuilt.

items.name: Entropic Slime
items.desc: Sticky Liquid Entropy that symbolizes danger. If the room has a few more or less unassuming jellyfish, it might be their fault.

items.name: Jellyfish Lamp
items.desc: They look like they're dancing and surround objects that radiate light and heat, as though they're instinctively drawn to the warm ocean surface. But they're not alive... or are they?

items.name: Moments In Dreams
items.desc: Some weighty matters must be hidden in your memories and their truth glimpsed in your dreams. Enter the sea of memory and find the deeply hidden clues, and then swim up with all your might— someone is still waiting for you to wake up.

items.name: Daybreak View
items.desc: A gentle expectation, an evanescent guide, it is both elusive and attractive at the same time. Through the wavering silk of the curtains, you look, and see that the dawn has come.

items.name: Roadside Convenience Store
items.desc: The store is actually open, but only people who need peace and quiet go inside to walk around. When you exclude noise and commotion, you also exclude a little bit of warmth.

items.name: Horizontal Neon Sign
items.desc: One of the most obvious signs in the night market, but it always seems to be out of order. If you can't find the sign, then use your sense of smell to find the familiar stall you're looking for.

items.name: Delicacy Signboard
items.desc: There are three requirements for making a signboard effective: First, it has to be striking. Second, it has to be striking. Third, it has to be striking.

items.name: Vertical Neon Sign
items.desc: From a certain angle, it looks like one of the signs is blocking the other. But that's okay; the signs won't fight because of that.

items.name: Distant View Window
items.desc: When you look into space, the planets before you seem almost within arm's reach. Visual observation is a powerful aid in relaxing the self, and the ensuing sense of loneliness also seems to be a kind of solitary space aesthetic... well, it sounds better than "spacing out", at least.

items.name: Spaceship
items.desc: A traveler of the cosmos, it absorbs starlight and converts it into energy to sustain its journey. It seems a little out of place in a world of spheres and curves, but that's the proof that it is a voyager.

items.name: Divergence Meter
items.desc: A special device made of Nixie tubes. Supposedly, whenever the world is reconstructed during a world line shift, the value it displays changes too. However only a few human beings can perceive this change.

items.name: Whiteboard of ヽ(*ﾟдﾟ)ノ
items.desc: How on earth did our world get linked to Magrasea... I've come up with a few hypotheses about that. Hm? You want to know what those emojis on the whiteboard mean? A-ah, no need to worry about that.

items.name: Sanctuary Curtain
items.desc: On the surface, it appears to be nothing more than an ordinary curtain, but in truth it is a special force field installed by an insane mad scientist, whose primary purpose is to hide what is behind it... So what's behind it, anyway?

items.name: Luminous Night Inlay
items.desc: Even an ephemeral dream can be felt by one's touch. Embed yourself into the mirror of the starry night, and appreciate it in silence.

items.name: Clear Blue Vista
items.desc: A vast and boundless blue, an abyss of thoughts that submerges the body and soul. Transcend the self, transcend everything.

items.name: Iron Gate
items.desc: The dormitory decoration system is all about the freedom to decorate these rooms the way you want, but this iron gate symbolizes unfreedom. Is this juxtaposition some kind of artistic expression too?

items.name: Mint Green Door
items.desc: A mint colored door frame, refreshing and lovely. It isn't going to make the piles of work you need to do any lovelier, though.

items.name: Lovely Pink Door
items.desc: A pink door frame, dreamy and beautiful. It isn't going to turn the piles of work you need to do a fleeting dream, though.

items.name: Wooden Door
items.desc: A wooden door frame. Its natural look should make whatever you are going to do next feel a bit special.

items.name: Mystery Arch
items.desc: A door separates the interior from the outside world, or it can also lead you into the unknown. Now take a guess. What will be waiting for you out there?

items.name: Shark Entrance
items.desc: The designer clearly don't know what the insides of a great white shark's mouth would look like, but the mysteriousness is what drove them to design this door. Will you die, or will you experience an exciting journey inside the great white shark's tummy? You will only learn the answer after stepping inside.

items.name: Mystery Cave
items.desc: An archway designed after the rock caves corroded with Entropy Liquid. To see the truth, one must brave themselves into the darkest and most dangerous places.

items.name: Loft-Style Door
items.desc: Minimalist designers have optimized the concept of a door, and now it is just a piece of wall that can be opened.

items.name: Classroom Door
items.desc: Some Agents once believed that learning was the greatest joy, until a certain Agent learned how to peep through the window on top. Stop — the excessive desire to learn will only make everyone suffer!

items.name: Winter Welcome Door
items.desc: When I came to receive you, the door and your shoulders were covered in snow. The mistletoe hung up here teaches us how to greet our loved ones with an embrace.

items.name: Minimalist Door
items.desc: If the door could speak, perhaps it might say, "Dammit, I lost to the Loft-style Door".

items.name: Out With The Old, In With The New
items.desc: People can't bid their past goodbye, but every second is a new beginning. Happy New Year, Exiles.

items.name: Rose and Crystal Archway
items.desc: Good, everyone's here. Now let the final game begin.

items.name: Castle Gate
items.desc: "Behind this castle gate hides the magic of happiness itself. So keen to come in already?"

items.name: Photo Booth Door
items.desc: "It's all dark ahead, can't see a thing... well, I suppose that's not true. It's beautiful once the sun comes out."

items.name: Stage Archway
items.desc: Come, march through this door, and show off your best side! Or perhaps your worst... the draw of the stage is magnifying one slice of life, putting to it the label of a dream.

items.name: Automatic Door
items.desc:
"Personnel not registered in system."
After a hundred failed attempts, you make a threatening gesture at it and it promptly opens up, a little frightened.

items.name: Glass Push Door
items.desc: Its metal frame ensures the stability of its structure, while the glass slab gives it a high-tech feeling. This should be a perfect door, but someone keeps bumping their head into the glass even with warning stickers pasted on it.

items.name: Neon Doors
items.desc: When you step out this door, all the coins in your hand become meaningless. Is this a blessing, or a nightmare?

items.name: Otherworldly Door
items.desc: Note: Do not use this door at 12 sharp, dead of night. No matter if it's for someone else, for yourself, or in response to a voice from the other side...

items.name: Door of Dreams
items.desc: "Home is behind, and the world lies ahead."

items.name: Under The Mistletoe
items.desc: Who says it's winter? As you smile while looking homeward, the snow just melts away.

items.name: Lunar Portal
items.desc: Through this round gateway is a lovely scene. Past its white walls are warm, well-lit homes. Who are you expecting to come through this doorway? ...Hm? The Professor, to give out red packets?

items.name: Sensor Door
items.desc: Every time multiple Dolls pass through this, the one at the back often gets squished. After this problem was highlighted, Croque added a verbal announcement feature. "Beep— Access granted. Beep— Warning, do not follow." "But I get squished all the same, don't I!?"

items.name: Jellyfish Arch
items.desc: A door that resembles a jellyfish. Your body feels light and fluffy the moment you step through, like you've fallen into the shallow waters where they live.

items.name: Edge of Wakefulness
items.desc: The divider between past and present, the boundary of memories and reality. Once you step through this door, your dreams will crumble and you will remember everything.

items.name: Night Market Entrance
items.desc: A very Oriental-themed door; passing through it takes you to a little nighttime world filled with all manner of sights and sounds. If you instead see a running battle through a chaotic marketplace, please exit and enter again.

items.name: Quiet Hatch
items.desc: A hatch with excellent soundproofing that also makes next to no noise when used; truly a crystallization of cutting-edge technology. In theory, you can play music at maximum volume and not disturb the neighbors. After all, you don't have any neighbors on a space station... or do you?

items.name: Through The Black Hole
items.desc: The closer you get to it, the stronger its gravity becomes, and no mass can escape its pull. But if you relax and cast yourself into it, will you be able to go beyond a certain boundary and arrive in a new world?

items.name: STEINS;GATE
items.desc: Through this portal you can behold the truth of the world. This is the choice of Steins Gate.

items.name: Whitegleam Stargate
items.desc: Behind this door is nothing less than the true realm of the real. No matter what is within, at least you've travelled through this door, no? From that angle, you've already won.

items.name: Floor
items.desc: Magrasea's basic flooring design. Simple but sturdy.

items.name: Checker Tiles
items.desc: These double-colored floor tiles can instantly bring you joy with the simplest design. It should be put inside dorms on the first floor though, otherwise those living downstairs are going to report them for disrupting their sleep.

items.name: Classroom Floor
items.desc: These exquisite ceramic tiles are easy to clean, but they're never cleaned properly. When they were first designed, Croque wanted to add traces of snack trash to them for realism, but the proposal was mercilessly shot down.

items.name: Concrete Floor
items.desc: One of Magrasea's universal flooring. It's very popular in Cyclopes. It's coarse but easy to clean and therefore very sought after by Agents who value efficiency.

items.name: Real Wood Flooring
items.desc: A warm, textured parquet floor that needs regular cleaning. The closer you are, the easier you get hurt - not even planks can avoid this axiom.

items.name: Wooden Floor
items.desc: Always change your shoes before stepping inside a room! No one wants to get someone else's shoe prints and gum on their clothes when they roll around on the floor!

items.name: Fleece carpet
items.desc: During Halloween season, such a luxurious fleece carpet is perfect to bring out a sense of the exciting unknown: Is this carpet clean? Or are there food crumbs hidden inside?

items.name: Artificial Beach Flooring
items.desc: A floor that mimics the texture of sand. It feels a little coarse. The difficulty in cleaning this floor is the price you need to pay for its look.

items.name: Entropic Rock flooring
items.desc: A floor designed after the underground cave in Copley Sector. Thick roots coiled in the ground, and the breaths of those creatures still linger in your ears. Who is calling?

items.name: Anti-Slip Patterned Flooring
items.desc: One of Croque's best works with Oasis' physics engine, it automatically stands Dolls that might fall down back up again. Dolls are saved by the flooring every day, but then they're punished by having to stand in place for at least a minute.

items.name: Crispy Floorboards
items.desc: Graced with a wafery lightness that surpasses normal flooring, it's rumored that they have soft, tasty layers sandwiched inside them. Tread lightly upon them, lest you disturb the people whispering to each other.
items.source: Obtained from the event "Heartfelt House of Cocoa".

items.name: Starry Magpie Floor Tiles
items.desc: The intersecting colors are like a brilliant galaxy beenath our feet. If I walked beneath the night sky that we both look up, would that count as meeting you?
items.source: Obtained through the "Wishing Starbridge Workshop" event

items.name: Winter Warm Floorboards
items.desc: Oh, how wonderful it is to treat a warm wooden floor with your bare feet. The cracking noises of thermal expansion are like a carol to the gospel of warmth.

items.name: Laminated Wood Flooring
items.desc: "I'm back." The only reply to these words is the hollow sounds of footsteps on the wooden floor.

items.name: Siheyuan Flooring
items.desc: When we were young, we didn't understand why our parents had to shovel the snow, until the first time we slipped and fell on snow that somebody didn't clear. The arrogance of adults comes from their experiences, and that is why we hate adults.

items.name: Galactic Stroll
items.desc: "Please take my heart," I said, "For I am happy to offer it to you."

items.name: Paradise's Stone Flooring
items.desc: Be free on the road to happiness! That's what the anti-slip tiles are for.

items.name: Black & White Tiles
items.desc: You might see patterned tiles, but they'll come out as transparent on the camera. Trust me, it's all in the layers.

items.name: Ballroom Floor
items.desc: Starry skies beneath, rainbows hanging above. A thousand-millionfold sonatas and odes, only so that my ration may accept my basest instincts.

items.name: Lab Floor
items.desc: This flooring conforms to the mental image of an immaculate laboratory. Burnished with a skin-friendly finish, it is said to be designed to the liking of a certain doctor who enjoys walking barefoot. Please don't bring this up in her presence.

items.name: Insulated Material Flooring
items.desc: As subdued and no-nonsense as its color suggests, further reinforcing the impression that people have of research institutes as hidebound and resistant to change.

items.name: Arcade Flooring
items.desc: Those without the courage to stand before the dance machine leave their steps here. Save for the dancer and the floor, who should know?

items.name: Ancient Flooring
items.desc: A piece of work with a long and varied history, carefully maintained to today. The traps hidden within are still more than functional. Watch your step.

items.name: Milano Carpet
items.desc:
Not only will your feet be relieved, but so will your ever-cautious heart. Take off your shoes and socks; the satisfaction of its 1000% softness is the signal to get the party started.
"Clearly, if a tree falls in a forest, it DOES make a sound."

items.name: Fluffy Snow Carpet
items.desc: It's soft and quiet when you gently step on it, yet for some reason you can still hear the crunch of treading on freshly-fallen snow in your heart. In your memories, who were you following; or rather, who was with you?

items.name: Stone Tiles of Prosperity
items.desc: Made of sturdy stone blocks that can take bang-snaps and the sequential bombardment of firecrackers. The Oasis martial arts star can attest to this, probably because she gave it a real workout.

items.name: Ruined Grassland
items.desc: This patch of grass retains the traces of bombardment. Few agents knew that the vegetation on its surface was just a mask, but now its steely-gray under-layer lies exposed. There are no agents assigned to maintain this area for the moment, so wait a while longer.

items.name: Sparkling Scales
items.desc: The layered ripples move with the seawater, projecting a web of faint light. Its soft texture is reminiscent of the shallow ocean floor and is self-cleaning to a certain degree, but in return... if you drop certain small parts on it, you'll never see them again.

items.name: Soft White Carpet
items.desc: Dawnlight pools on the clean floor, radiating a faint flow. If you step on it barefoot, you can feel its soft texture caressing your feet.

items.name: Night Market Flooring
items.desc: Cars can still pass through here in the daytime, but once the sun goes down, it becomes part of the night market. Now who's going to zoom past next, some action movie star?

items.name: Space Flooring
items.desc: Made of a waterproof and wear-resistant material and featuring a modular design, it combines convenience while meeting aesthetic requirements. In space, having to replace an entire section of flooring because you spilled coffee on it is a huge pain—thus the designers hope that you'll just have to wipe it.

items.name: Infinite Cosmos
items.desc: People easily get lost on an aimless journey. In the eternal, boundless night, the only signposts to mark your path are drifting stars.

items.name: Yggdrasil's Floorboards
items.desc: Ordinary floorboards, you say? ...Hahaha... Muhahaha—Oh comrade of mine, this is no ordinary Japanese-style tatami mat... Rather, it was made of branches from Yggdrasil which I harvested myself! Warm in winter, cool in summer, it is the great regulator of the lab's temperature!

items.name: Pearly Tiles
items.desc: Leaving even a single mark upon these pearlescent tiles would be a sin; it would be a pain to clean as well. The Sanctifiers can fly, but we can't. We'll have to trouble Jessie a little more.

items.name: Seashells and Starfish
items.desc: As an archaeologist, Fern is convinced that the status of Chanzhi's Neural Cloud is going to be a good research subject. "She's actually convinced that shells can be exchanged for money. Do you know how ancient that concept is?!"

items.name: Artistic Carpet
items.desc: While messiness is a form of art, spilling your coffee on Banxsy's white carpet might lead to you witnessing her subversive art style.

items.name: Rug of Blessing
items.desc: If the cat hadn't just come back inside from playing in a mud pool, surely every footprint on this rug would represent good fortune...

items.name: Red Velvet Rug
items.desc: The advantage of short-haired carpets is that they absorb water easily, but their disadvantage is that they're hard to wash. Thus are both sides of an issue elegantly displayed in a single rug.

items.name: Directionless Boat
items.desc: Just like walking the boundless galaxy, our destination is where gravity directs.

items.name: Glowing Platform
items.desc: Why is the floor glowing? That's a good question! Once you start harboring doubts, you're a step closer to the truth.

items.name: Multifunction Platform
items.desc: Featuring a clean color palette of white, orange and technological gray, as well as chic numerals and strange lined patterns—that's the high-tech feeling for you! It's okay even in people don't understand the design concept, so long as it looks cool.

items.name: Ground Warning Marker
items.desc: Typically pasted at the entrance to secret areas as a warning. Don't treat it as a joke, or else... Nothing will happen. People have tried it many times already.

items.name: Floor Vent
items.desc: Ensuring the smooth flow of air is essential for a large building. Er... It's just a decoration? Never mind, then.

items.name: Arcade Floor Lights
items.desc: The path lies head. Are you willing to cast away all your hope for happiness?

items.name: Stained Carpet
items.desc: Question not what made the stains here, and your chances of leaving here alive may increase...... Good, you're sitting at about 0.001%.

items.name: Snowy Rug
items.desc: We sink into the deep snow, and from then on we see nothing else.

items.name: Woven Rug
items.desc: Our fates are like the red string that binds our destiny, and before we know it, we've woven another year that lies behind us.

items.name: Zebra Crossing
items.desc: The stripes of this crossing protrude out from the road's surface, which once drove people to summon up the magic of innocence and skip along them. But now, nobody does it anymore.

items.name: Central Plot
items.desc: This square patch of grassland was spared destruction due to its special position. It relaxes the soul as you gaze and walk upon it, and you can also let your dogs and cats loose to see them roll around on it, but not Sako— it really will dig a hole through it.

items.name: Hardwood Flooring
items.desc: Flat, even, wooden floorboards. Since it's a basic building material, it's been repaired very well. It's better suited as a platform base compared to more complex greenery.

items.name: Whispered Memories
items.desc: Memories are imprints of days gone by, solidified and darkened. The past surrounds us and whispers in a rustling voice; there will always be someone who's fascinated by it and stands here to keep it company.

items.name: Storage Space
items.desc: A storage space hidden in the ground that makes full use of the space station's internal structure. It contains all kinds of daily and emergency supplies. It's deeper than you might think, so be careful when retrieving stuff, lest you fall in and become part of those supplies...

items.name: Observation Logs
items.desc: When the logs just started being kept, the data and files in each category were still fairly neat. But after a few lazy watch-standers took over, the bad habit of randomly chucking pages around quickly spread among the crew...

items.name: Orbital Diagram
items.desc: Planets move in fixed orbits and their intersecting orbits comprise a glowing chessboard. You can consider it a mystery waiting to be solved, or the romance unique to space.

items.name: RaiNet AccessBattlers
items.desc: Nyahaha, Faris' winning streak is still going♪ Nyanya?! Isn't that the Professor nya? Professorrr~ Want to play a tense and exciting game of RaiNET with me? I'm sure you'll love it ~nya!

items.name: Throne's Carpet
items.desc: The path to the most high throne is padded in pure white. Once you start upon this path, there's no looking back.

items.name: Cardboard Bed
items.desc:
A bed created from common cardboard boxes. Reportedly makes Dolls think of when they came out of factory way back... really?
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Folding Bed
items.desc:
A bed for Agents to rest on. Sturdier than a cardboard box, and most importantly, it won't be picked up and thrown away by the cleaners.
<color=#bebebe>[Provides 1 extra living space]</color>

items.name: Lazy Bed
items.desc:
Art needs to be set free, and accompanying the desire to create is also a nigh-irresistible drowsiness. Perhaps part of making art is overcoming the urge to sleep?
<color=#bebebe>[Provides 1 extra living space]</color>

items.name: Gothic Bed
items.desc:
This Gothic Bed is the centerpiece of the entire Halloween experience. Its Dark Ages inspired design will usher every sleeper into a magnificent and mysterious dream world, where they meet the Enchanted Rabbit, the Queen of Hearts, and 500 Bald Men.
<color=#bebebe>[Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Coconut Hammock
items.desc:
A hammock that seems good to bounce and twist. Go too hard, though, and a coconut might fall and end your rest time early. Do be careful.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Rock Beds
items.desc:
A bed modelled after the layered rocks in Copley's underground caverns. Only the weak need soft mattresses. Are you weak?
<color=#bebebe>[Provides 1 extra living space]</color>

items.name: Classroom Desk (Nap Mode)
items.desc:
The biggest drawback to lying down on this to sleep compared to sprawling on your desk is that lying down makes it easier to clip through the model — and Antonina refuses to fix that bug.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Christmas Eve Sledge Bed
items.desc:
The sky outside the window is clear and cold. We shall lie on the bed, and let the sled take us on a romp in the snowfields of our dreams.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Portable Camp Bed
items.desc:
The advantage of camp beds are their portability. When you take your time to pack them up, you've already betrayed their original intention of design!
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Bamboo Bed
items.desc:
When you wrap the covers around yourself and sit on this bed, you're no longer a child, but a mighty general or an elegant dowager. Come, give your orders before the adults come back!
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Moonlit Invitation Boat
items.desc:
Row, row, row your boat, into the starry sea, may your dreams be soft and warm, buoyed by the nebulae...
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Fairgrounds Bench
items.desc:
Much of time spent by tourists tasting popcorn and cotton candy is shared with it. So long as there isn't rainwater and dried gum on it.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Circular Mattress
items.desc:
A corner for actors to have brief rests. In order to prevent slacking, the originally present translucent curtain here was removed.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Titanium Workbench
items.desc:
A rare metal used for the construction of spacecraft, incredibly tough and difficult to work. Though with a current lack of need for spacecraft, it'll have to be just a desk suitable for research work.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Stainless Steel Workbench
items.desc: Stainless steel originally used for surgical instruments or a once flagship phone's edges, now relegated to being used for a table suitable for research work.

items.name: Eternity's Beddings
items.desc:
This bed's very fond of people. It wishes people would sleep here longer, ever longer... till eternity.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Snow-White Bed
items.desc:
Long-awaited reunions are oft viscous, helped by the cold. Upon a snow-white, winter fades.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Temporary Bedframe
items.desc:
A camp bed modified from a stretcher, available for everyone to lie down on. Those of the Medical Department are less inclined, though. For them, sorting Neural Data on this bed is an arduous task to undertake.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Waking Time
items.desc:
Whether you're sinking into sleep or into thought, a comfortable bed is a must. Put your all into its warm embrace. It will accept all.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Long Dining Table
items.desc:
For the sake of all that is good, this is for food, but people just won't stop lying down on it. This does mean that you can call whatever's on it ""delicious"", including your friends.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Sleeping Capsule
items.desc:
Designed as a capsule and created with fine materials for the mattress, the capsule can block a portion of incoming light, and is conducive towards deep sleep. Comes with a monitoring system that will record your sleep data. And the mutterings in your sleep sometimes, too.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Stargazing Bed
items.desc:
Recline between the stars however you desire, and sleep like a babe. Impossible to fall off of no matter how you twist and turn, this piece imbues an utmost sense of safety in you.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Simple Stool
items.desc: This cardboard box has been filled up. It should be safe to sit on.

items.name: Rotating Round Stool
items.desc: A stool designed after the real ones in fast food chains. The point is to deliberately make it feel uncomfortable to sit on, so that customers will hurry up and leave once they're done eating.

items.name: Student Chair
items.desc: The angle at which it leans is connected to how many friends you have and how trendy the topics you discuss are. This mode can also be engaged during lesson time to copy homework and read light novels.

items.name: Eames Chair
items.desc: The world's first mass-produced chair, its intricate structure can take an extraordinary amount of weight — but Aegis still can't sit on it.

items.name: Shadowed Chair
items.desc: The Shadowed Chair is a lone throne of Halloween. You won't be able to hold anything but a slim glass of wine once you've sat on top of it, even if you only drink coke.

items.name: Motorboat
items.desc: It's time to get on a motorboat and have fun in the ocean! Want to experience an adrenaline rush? The shark fins that has been following you should be more than happy to help!

items.name: Sitting Toilet
items.desc: There's a fine line between rumination and release. Do what you want to do and let those who see it come to their own conclusions.

items.name: Holiday Beach Umbrella
items.desc: Humans are truly exceptional at finding unnecessary things for themselves to do. This is exemplified perfectly by those who reapply sunscreen once an hour while under shade.

items.name: Dreambound Chair
items.desc: Tis a fine new year's eve, the night is yet young, and eyes shine between gentle smiles. The image of a fine lady in an inebriating dream is inscribed upon an old chair in the lady's chamber.
items.source: Acquired via purchasing Pendent Aria - Stage 1 Pack

items.name: Winter Sofa Chair
items.desc: Winter sofas are very popular with furry creatures, such as Sako, Betty or Sol... Hm? Is something wrong?

items.name: Soft Black Leather Chair
items.desc: If you put it in front of a black wall, it gives the sense of floating in mid-air when you take pictures of it. Being chuuni is part of being alone, so become the King of the Night from this moment on!

items.name: Soft Black Leather Armchair
items.desc: If you put it in front of a black wall, it gives the sense of floating in mid-air when you take pictures of it. Being introspective or chuuni are both mere shadows of loneliness.

items.name: Little Bamboo Bench
items.desc: The squeaking noises it makes are very demanding on your sitting posture and make them most unsuitable for certain neurotic STEM undergrads. Perhaps this is why science never flourished in ancient China.

items.name: Folding Stool
items.desc: A folding stool that the older generation used to sit on, but which has no place in public places today.

items.name: Pure White Dreamscape (Single)
items.desc: I hope that someday I'll find someone that I can share everything with, so I won't be alone throughout the long journey of life.

items.name: Lil' Plane
items.desc: In the age of the Collapsed Clouds blocking away the route to that veritable ocean of stars, to be a pilot is naught but a lofty dream. Earhart, you've been on that ride 4 times now, and you're still not tired of it?

items.name: Leap of Faith Simulator
items.desc: Outside of a dream, this simulator allows you the luxury of complete safety after the greatest of falls.

items.name: Round Swivel Stool
items.desc: A little stool commonly used for applying makeup and snacking at lunchtime. Rustic and solid, giving a feeling of safety with its leather texture.

items.name: Ballroom Stool
items.desc: The maddest of the world could not hope to match one who watches an entire rock concert sitting down.

items.name: Bar Stool
items.desc: The chair's tall because the bar is tall, and the bar is tall because the bartender can reach it. So, you see, who's really in control here in this so called "Service Industry"?

items.name: Swivel Chair - Black
items.desc: This chair has a stainless steel frame, plastic rollers and a round, black leather seat; a timeless, unchanging design. When you sit down on it. be careful that it doesn't slip out from under you and hit the glass.

items.name: Swivel Chair - Blue
items.desc: This chair has a stainless steel frame, plastic rollers and a round, blue leather seat; a timeless, unchanging design. When you sit down on it. be careful that it doesn't slip out from under you and hit the glass.

items.name: Metal Chair - RSM1
items.desc:
"The hardcore sensation of being in close contact with metal."
If you want to rest on it, you might be better off laying a blanket down first. Apparently, Turing was going to add a smart temperature control function to it.

items.name: Adjustable Chair
items.desc: High chairs situated in corners. Nothing beats observing others fight their most difficult battles from high above.

items.name: Arcade Chair
items.desc: Normal chairs situated in the arcade, attuned to human anatomy, with mounted wheels. It's time to run over that dumbass over there laughing while watching!

items.name: Antique Armchair
items.desc: To be brave is to not turn back when patted on the back.

items.name: Afternoon Leisure
items.desc:
Just about everyone has wanted to do this at some point in time: to sit on a chair, thinking of nothing, doing nothing, neither sleeping nor working, just sitting there in bliss.
"We fight for peace and work for our leisure."

items.name: Long-Legged Chair
items.desc: Festive preparations are always complicated, so at times like these you need to stick the troublemakers on top of these to keep them still... Hey! Yes, I'm talking to you, Sol! No running on the carpet!

items.name: Park Stone Seat
items.desc: A stone seat of the kind that's commonly seen in walled gardens. It doesn't seem that cold under warm light. It gives your legs a brief respite once you're tired—wait, Betty, that doesn't mean you should be standing on it.

items.name: Temporary Seat
items.desc: Put a medical crate on a small trolley and you have a temporary seat. Since it's so surprisingly comfortable, there's always a Doll who accidentally falls asleep on top of it. Perhaps they expended too many operands.

items.name: Small Jellyfish Stool
items.desc: A bouncy, slippery stool, like a jelly. Please remember that it is NOT an emergency ration and that you are NOT to taste or even lick it.

items.name: Superstar Chair
items.desc: It once took part in many vicious brawls and has seen all manner of excitement on this street. And now, it has finally decided to settle down and be a good chair.

items.name: Observation Chair
items.desc: A comfortable and simple chair for observation. You can turn it anywhere you want to help in various observational tasks. There are no cumbersome armrests on either side, but there's a handhold on the back, making it very useful when you're moving it around or when you're experiencing zero-G conditions.

items.name: Stargazing Chair
items.desc: It provides an unmatched field of vision for stargazing and allows you to chat comfortable with your friends among the stars. The joy of exploring space lies in relaxing within it.

items.name: Soft Sofa
items.desc:
A large red sofa, even softer than the smaller ones. Hard not to fall asleep when you lie down.
<color=#bebebe>[Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: "Styx" Bean Bag Couch
items.desc:
A bean bag couch designed after the Entropic—"Styx". The thorns were removed for safety reasons, and the shell was made with soft materials. 
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Shaded Sofa
items.desc:
The Shaded Sofa is the upgraded version of a Shaded Chair. It has twice as much capacity, and has twice as much loner energy! ...Huh?
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Eames Sofa
items.desc:
This pure white sofa is a disaster waiting to happen for homemakers, but the artists just won't listen.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: UL-GSA's Inflatable Cushion
items.desc:
An animal-shaped inflatable mat that came with the UL-GSA model, impressively bouncy and comfortable. Please don't bounce too hard, or you might find yourself going through the ceiling or flying out of the Oasis entirely.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Winter Long Sofa
items.desc:
As the storm rages outside, the stove inside blazes merrily. Since we've got a place for ourselves, let's go ahead and sing!
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Soft Black Leather Sofa
items.desc:
You placed these cushions on the sofa with your own hands, allowing it to become the night's embrace, inviting you to become a traitor to the individualist cause.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Pure White Dreamscape (Twin)
items.desc:
We'll share our fate, my lives, our fantasies, our realities... And the last marshmallow tonight.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Fairgrounds Chair
items.desc:
After a back was added to the bench, you can in a more comfortable position eat popcorn and cotton candy, kiss your lover by your side... and a singular lonely philosopher.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Cardholder's Sofa-Bed
items.desc:
High-class and secretive. No one will know whether you're on a bender or sleeping here. Just don't spill any alcohol.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Metal Sofa - RSM4
items.desc:
""Lying on it makes you feel cold to the bone"".
Better to add a blanket underneath first if you intend to rest on this. Supposedly, Turing's planning to add a smart adjustment system to it.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Arcade Sofa (Blue)
items.desc:
An arcade city chair. Ice-like in color, but not softness. When one sits down, the raucousness doesn't disappear, but it stops being your business for a little.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Arcade Sofa (Orange)
items.desc:
An arcade city chair. Fire-like in color, but not persistence. When one sits down, the desire to win doesn't disappear, but it settles down for a little.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Scraggly Sofa
items.desc:
Wailing, pleads for mercy, insults, hanging onto the last vestiges of dignity... you've heard the sound everyone who has sat on this chair has made. Now it's your turn.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Lazy Vortex
items.desc:
Everyone wants me to fight for my own future, but I only wish to live a quiet life. My sofa's prepared a surprise party for me, and how can I turn that down?
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Snowy Sofa
items.desc:
From one end to other, from summer to winter. Less passionate words between one another, and more laughter about past years and happenings.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Park Bench
items.desc:
Sit for a little. Chat with friends, count your blessings for the past year. Wide enough for a person to lie down. Aki doesn't say this is the most popular piece of equipment in the park for no reason.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Sleepy Embrace
items.desc:
A warm and flexible embrace, providing the most rejuvenating sleep. When one is lonely, a hug might help. Even if it's from a jellyfish sofa.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Morning Rest
items.desc:
Keeping a cool head in cruel reality is commendable, but you can return here at any time to enjoy some rest, for yourself and no one else.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Stargazing Sofa
items.desc:
The half-globe shaped sofa hovers between the orbits of stars. Sit within, and you can block away the part of the world that represents chaos. What remains is a serene spot of distant stargazing.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Upa Sanctuary
items.desc:
""Ehehe~this sofa and Upa are Mayushi's favorites. Eh? You wanna cuddle with the Upa? Sure, help yourself~""
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Temple's Asylum
items.desc:
The moment you collapse into this soft sofa, the sound of giggling and animosity arises. Apparently, they are discussing the flavor of some canned drink... could it be? The voice of someone both familiar and strange.
<color=#bebebe>[Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Restroom Seat
items.desc:
Wordlessly accepts anyone who is in need of rest—whether it's the master of the house or a guest. Its existence is enough to express that the temple is not always so solemn and aloof.
<color=#bebebe>[Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Storage Box Table
items.desc: It is a storage box that's good as a table too. Perhaps this design will become trendy one day?

items.name: Fast Food Table
items.desc: A table from fast food chains with various sauces and old magazines from 12 years ago placed on top. It's hardcore nostalgia.

items.name: Student Desk
items.desc: Don't leave your video game magazines inside, unless you can reach the classroom earlier than the teacher the next day!

items.name: Tea Party Round Table
items.desc: The table at which Dolls gather for tea parties. Data on its appearance was provided by the Professor. Traces of wear and tear were removed during this table's design, and it felt sturdy under his touch.

items.name: Gorgeous Round Table
items.desc: A round table with various holiday foods on top. Legend has it that the electronic sheep favored round summoning altars, and for that reason this round table was borrowed for use during the Halloween eve.

items.name: Afternoon Tea Table
items.desc: A tea table full of desserts. Enjoy them all you want, but please note that a rotten tooth does not count as a workplace injury.

items.name: Seaside Picnic Table
items.desc: A small table with a picnic basket, cocktails and ice buckets on top. It's going to look all good until the waves slap you in the face.

items.name: Steel Crate Tea Table
items.desc: It carries on the glorious tradition of a certain group that likes using crates as tea tables, and also comes with the espressos that artists love best.

items.name: Grand Gala Table
items.desc:
In a gentle night, under a veil of the stars, in a most romantic gala—From across the long table, she offers her regards to you with glass in hand, the moon's luster in her smile.
<color=#969696>Converts into Refight Overflow Energy upon re-acquisition</color>
items.source: Acquired via [Cards & Bestowments]; Purchased in the shop

items.name: Nora's Deadline Desk
items.desc: Witness to the literary giant Nora's deadline rushes. When she pours forth prose, she conceives upon this desk. When inspiration runs dry, she slams this same desk in anger. Certainly a piece of furniture possessing both creativity and maturity.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Winter Feast Table
items.desc: Nothing puts the heart at ease more than a winter night gathering. Even if technology has improved to the point where we can warm ourselves with electricity, we still seek to be close to the ones who are like us.

items.name: Mini Tea Table
items.desc: Once laziness starts, it's as hard to hold back as a flood. This table exists merely to remind you not to throw your stuff all over the floor, at least.

items.name: Little Tea Table
items.desc: Since hardly any mobile games can be played with one hand, it has become a simple memorial item -- used to remember the days when people would drink tea as they chatted.

items.name: Sweet Feast
items.desc: The past is set in stone, the present is happiness, while the future is completely unknown... That's the life of a person in love. If your lover can't give you a joyful now, then what difference is there between being in love and being alone?

items.name: Printer Table
items.desc: Table upon which a printer rests. Usually used for scripts, but also occasionally for some stinker a photographer caught earlier in the day.

items.name: Computer Desk
items.desc: A desk with a camera and computer for editing on it. No one knows if the BSoD or the automatic update will come first, but something's bound to happen.

items.name: Ballroom Table
items.desc: We light our spirits by candlelight while the music traverses through people's very being. We shall put our most hated selves into the revelry, seeking a grand fiesta of indulgence.

items.name: Sterile Workbench
items.desc:
An austere, spotless workbench.
Please adhere strictly to the relevant disinfection procedures before using.

items.name: Director's Desk
items.desc: A bigger titanium workbench that can hold more stuff, perfectly matched to the director's role and actual workload.

items.name: Battle Over Magrasea
items.desc: A fierce head-to-head game, a good stress reliever. Due to frequent use, the joysticks tend to malfunction.

items.name: Bewitching Hour's Table
items.desc: The friendly and approachable host has prepared the finest of morsels for all guests. It sits at the head of the table, savoring each and every expression of terror.

items.name: Dining Counter
items.desc: We've got gingerbread men, coffee and cola, bread, ham and half a turkey. Everything's ready! ...Wait, HALF a turkey? ...Why is there only half a turkey left!?

items.name: Crystal Ball Table
items.desc: Winter is the season of magical familiars, and every snowflake swirling in the glass globe is a witch's blessing.

items.name: Park Table
items.desc: The tea in the pot is just the right temperature, served by a kind and considerate big sister. Meanwhile, the snacks on the table are all gone; since it's a yearly gathering, we'll focus more on the joy and less on the nagging.

items.name: Temporary Desk
items.desc: A Medical Department push-cart modified into a temporary desk. It isn't very spacious, but it comes fully equipped and it can handle overtime shifts all night long. If possible, however, it would be best to let it keep resting.

items.name: Small Jellyfish Table
items.desc: This table has floated up out of a pool of sticky Liquid Entropy. Legends say that late at night, it swims around the room, making sticky squishy noises.

items.name: After Moonfall
items.desc: The sun rises and the moon sets as the stars move and turn. When the table, chair, and everything on them are illuminated, the light of dawn becomes a gentle wakeup call. Such an awakening is more desirable than a crude alarm bell.

items.name: Stargazing Table
items.desc: The universe is beautiful because of its stars, and the sidereal expanse here is by no means empty. A tiny projection can turn a scene of decay into a marvel of the cosmos.

items.name: Gelbana
items.desc: "Mayushii's banana became a gelbana... Gelbanas are all gloopy, droopy, soft and squishy, Mayushii doesn't like them... They have no flavor and they aren't tasty at all..."

items.name: PhoneWave (name subject to change)
items.desc: Until now, I have relived the past countless times... the path to truth is always difficult. It is the start of everything, and also the witness to the end of all things.

items.name: Ammunition Box
items.desc: Storage boxes of various sizes. After multiple incidents of these boxes breaking down, Persicaria issued another stern warning to all Dolls: Do not sit on them before they are filled up ever again.

items.name: Cardboard Nightstand
items.desc: A designer Doll insisted that there should be nightstands next to every bed, otherwise a bedroom will never be complete. So we achieved this by putting two cardboard boxes together... sort of.

items.name: Many Cartons
items.desc: Many cardboard boxes filled with miscellaneous items that the Exiles have found in the Oasis. Perhaps these will come in handy later, but usually the storage boxes will only collect dust instead of whatever item kept inside.

items.name: Clothes Rack
items.desc: Many Dolls pay attention to what they wear and how they look, even when they are stranded in Magrasea. Every morning, they adjust their clothes before leaving for work—as if everyone was still in the real world.

items.name: Bottled Water
items.desc: A question many Dolls have wondered about: Is there any difference between the Operand in drinking water and those that constitute landscape water? Croque's answer to that is: "They're the same thing."

items.name: Heater
items.desc: Although the Oasis usually does not need extra heating, this finely cast metal piece has been preserved as an ornament.

items.name: Sealed Box
items.desc: We all thought it was a mysterious sealed box in the beginning, but after cutting it open we found that it was just a decoration made to look like a box. Now we have repaired it and put back in place to commemorate this interesting adventure.

items.name: Table Lamp
items.desc: No matter how noisy it is outside the room, once you turn on the lamp, this warm little room becomes everything.

items.name: Giant Floor Clock
items.desc: A giant, bulky floor clock is perfect to display your wealth. This and those electronic clocks won't make loud chimes at midnight, and they certainly can't summon an electronic sheep.

items.name: Iron Cage
items.desc: An ordinary iron cage. Leave it unattended for a while, and you may find mysterious creatures growing from it.

items.name: Cheers Mini TV
items.desc: A miniature TV modelled after the logo of a famous video site. "Cheers!"

items.name: Bakery Tools Cabinet
items.desc: A simple but elegant cabinet, filled with tools for making desserts plus some dessert recipes. How will you know if you are a dessert genius without even trying first?

items.name: Basket of Berries
items.desc: Freshly picked autumn berries were put together with a straw hat... Who on earth left the hat here? The scent of flowers still lingers on it.

items.name: Sunflower Vase
items.desc: Fake sunflowers made with silk inside a ceramic floor vase. These are as pretty as the real ones and easy to look after.

items.name: A Small Boat
items.desc: The stranded little boat invites a coconut tree to join her dream full of little galaxies.

items.name: Beach Light
items.desc: These lights are perfect for summer nights. They illuminate the surroundings and allow you to recognize just how many mosquitoes are near.

items.name: Surfboard
items.desc: Every surfboard dreams of riding the waves with a cool owner one day. The joy of challenging the extremes is amazing, so why would anyone give a damn about the ATK reduction debuff that's happening 20 seconds later?

items.name: Soft Tentacles
items.desc: An ornament imitating the tentacles of Demiurge, the advanced Entropy. These tiny tentacles are super curious about the outside world, but they won't prey on people like Demiurge did.

items.name: "Cocytus" Floor Lamp
items.desc: A floor lamp designed after the Entropic "Cocytus". It reminds Sol of her unfortunate experience of getting slapped so hard her vision blacked out, but the lamp itself is perfectly sturdy. No need to worry about electric leakage.

items.name: Open Cage
items.desc: A cage placed on the ground, still wrapped in chains, but its door is left open. Did the little bird that broke free from the confines of this cage finally find freedom as she had desired?

items.name: Modern Bookshelf
items.desc: It doesn't matter what books are on it, as long as their titles are in a foreign language.

items.name: Classroom Lectern
items.desc: The questions, answers and class rankings for the term exams all lay here once. Truly a place to set one's heart racing.

items.name: Classroom Cabinet
items.desc: Hiding in here is a super classic scene for many high school light novels...and horror games.

items.name: Squat Toilet
items.desc: Once you chose this place, there was no longer any point in holding back.

items.name: Sink and Mirror
items.desc: An Agent once made a video here and found that it wasn't herself in the mirror, but Baalia. Careful, she might be among us...

items.name: Plunger
items.desc: When things just won't go down well, perhaps we might need to take a step back and unblock our thoughts...

items.name: Mini Bathtub
items.desc: A bathtub that fits one. If you can't stretch your legs, you can't slip and fall inside it. Someone once tried to change the material of the bathtub's floor to be the same as the anti-slip flooring, but then they discovered that the water turned into jelly — we're all made of operand, after all.

items.name: Silent Camera
items.desc: Be it villainy, tragedy or a perfectly ordinary day, someone will record it all and pass the truth on through smoke and mystery, and into the future.

items.name: Band Drum Kit
items.desc: The crashing of drums and cymbals isn't always noise that people dislike, although that's only if they're being played by someone skilled. Otherwise, please prepare a set of earphones beforehand.
