items.source: Obtained through Enigma Black Hole - Crevice Exploration: Energy Level Transition

items.name: ZOO - Baalia Cafe
items.desc: Though they say coffee without sugar or milk is better for you... is there really a need to stick a maple syrup waffle into it? Just let that Baalia make it for you.
items.source: Happy Zoo Offline Collaboration promotion item

items.name: "Good Night"
items.desc: We shall go gentle into that good night, before the dying of the light, singing goblets betwixt their sight.
items.source: Acquired Through Limited Pack [Besotted Evernight Fashion Pack]

items.name: Ghost Pirate Jack
items.desc: A legendary pirate who once sailed the seven seas, and faded into the annals of history without a trace... According to a certain Scholar of Folklore, pirates who had fallen overboard while afflicted with drunkenness were all referenced in this dignified manner.

items.name: Petit Persicaria
items.desc: A petite Persicaria, stored in a cabinet like a work of art. It is exquisitely made, comes with its own lighting, and its tremendous similarity to the original speaks of the love with which it was crafted. "If this miniature me can help you in some way... then gazing at each other like this isn't a bad thing."
items.source: Redeemed by purchasing the Persicaria Nendoroid

items.name: EMR's Electromagnetic Transmitter
items.desc: An electromagnetic emitter that came with EMR. You can use it as your clothes rack, but it may cause abnormal loss of electronic equipments.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Butler-36's Assistant
items.desc: The cleaning robot given away free with the Butler-36 model. The newly-added illumination function even allows it to be used as a bedlight. Careful though, it might treat your unwashed socks as garbage and dispose of them.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: UL-AP's Drink Dispenser
items.desc: A test-tube-shaped drink machine given away with the UL-AP model, allowing Dolls to enjoy a variety of drinks in the dorm at any time. Supposedly, if you insert a Diggcoin and enter a command, it will dispense a glass and fill it with any beverage you desire.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: "Flawless Eucharist"
items.desc: "Lord Eosphorus, I was thinking. After consulting the data stored in the Art Sector, could it be that I, who was named after the "Eucharist", was made from the body and blood of the Creator? Aw, I'm just kidding~"

items.name: PSRA's Orrery
items.desc: A planetary mobile that came with the PSRA Doll. It simulates the movements of planetary bodies. It ceaselessly illustrates the movements of the stars, allowing people to understand the secrets of the cosmos at any time -- That is, unless there's no power.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: UL-Nurse's Roller Table
items.desc: The roller table that came with the UL-Nurse. It's extraordinarily stable and can be used to transport drinks, medications, as well as you after you fell for one of her pranks.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: ATT-Type Coat Rack
items.desc: A rack gifted alongside the ATT Model. Designed with care, crafted tough, and capable of supporting a great many items, such as weighted boxing gloves, a punching bag, and the occasional person.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: E-GAST's Telescopic Handle Suitcase
items.desc: A suitcase that comes for free with the E-GAST. Its outstanding partition design allows many kinds of items to be stored within, allowing for travel to anywhere you wish at the drop of a hat! As for the bills such adventures rack up, let the E-GAST's owner worry about that.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: New Year's Gift Shelf
items.desc: This bogu rack is full of New Year's spirit and was personally decorated by Persicaria, with many little pouches containing gifts on its shelves. Huh? What flew past just now — Betty's making off with the biggest one in her mouth! Get back here!
items.source: Obtained through the "New Year's Gift" event

items.name: Forensic 3.6's Toolkit
items.desc: A toolkit that comes free with the Forensic 3.6, used to preserve and simulate crime scene situations. The chalk used to draw outlines of bodies on the ground keeps disappearing; the identity of the Great Chalk Thief is still under investigation.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: CM-Idol's Microphone
items.desc: A microphone that comes with the CM-Idol, featuring good audio sensitivity and smart noise cancellation. It can be linked to any nearby loudspeakers. Its standing design frees up both hands, but from time to time, people get so into the music while singing that they pick it up and dance with it...
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Sweeper Robot
items.desc: It's round and white, cute and clean, and it springs into action immediately whenever cleaning needs to be done. What a good little kid it is... Ah, it seems to have turned into a kitty chair. That's fine too; now both Centaureissi and Clukay will like it.

items.name: Puzzle's Chisel
items.desc: Puzzle's beloved chisel. Beneath its blade, art was deconstructed and reborn, as all creation was hewn from ignorance. And now, this chisel is displayed here— A tool to make works of art has become a work of art itself.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: De Lacey's Mechanical Tail
items.desc: De Lacey's favorite mechanical tail. Strong, agile, handy, multi-purpose, it can be dismantled and its parts interchanged, making it the handiest helper for any Doll technician. Each cable and access port bears the weighty mission of healing the wounded.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Vigorous Tempo
items.desc: When you strike it forcefully, it vibrates in time with your heartbeat. Hold on to its rhythm amidst the audience's cheers and screams, matching your feelings to the tempo—the ripples of every strike you make will echo throughout all of Magrasea.

items.name: Cool Summer Sandcastle
items.desc: Just as there's an Oasis in the cloud, there's a sandbank by the sea. Surely building a sandcastle is a necessary part of enjoying the ocean, right? It looks sturdy enough and the water won't sweep it away. Perhaps it has a tiny little Professor inside it...

items.name: Mini Nanaka
items.desc: A miniature Nanaka that's like unto a work of art, stored within your cabinet. It's well-made and has its own lighting, while it's incredible fidelity to its original model shows the love with which it was crafted. "Can such a delicate little body project the same cheerful healing energy as her? I'd love to hear her sing!"

items.name: Undine's Band Kit
items.desc: The default instruments for Undine's marching band. It contains a bass drum, a bugle, a clarinet and snare drums, whose outstanding performance has earned them rave reviews during shows. However, what really determines the overall quality of the show is the skill level of the performers, as well as the ability of the conductor—Undine is supremely confident in the latter.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Faraway Darkstar
items.desc: Before losing herself in dreams, she once stared for a long time at the distant starlight. After much time passed, someone awakened her to witness the deaths of stars and the end of the universe.
items.source: Obtained during the [Precious Company – Imminent Gala] event

items.name: Turing's Cube
items.desc: A glowing cube that Turing carries with her at all times. This mysterious hexahedron contains Turing's past and contains the light of intellect and will. Playing with this cube won't make you smarter, but it will satisfy your curiosity—there's always an agent out there willing to give it a try.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Taisch's Fox Buggy
items.desc: Taisch's beloved multifunctional cart. It serves as a PMV, item storage, and its dolly lift mechanism lets her work in high places. It was original supposed to be Arctic Fox's home, but Arctic Fox doesn't stay in it often... Even so, it's still called the Fox Buggy!
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Persicaria - Shining Edge's Bow
items.desc: A ranged weapon that Persicaria - Shining Edge received. It was developed by Croque and Antonina for use with high-energy taser blades and possesses killing power far in excess of what a normal Agent can deliver. Laden with feelings, symbolic of growth, this newborn bladebearer gleams with a cool, keen light.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Colorful Ripples
items.desc: Waves and water, colorful balls, and a great watergun battle to boot! On this special Christmas, we'll let you experience the lovely snow and rippling waves that you can only find in the Oasis~ The winner gets a mysterious special prize too—Take aim at Florence. Water guns fire!

items.name: Vee's Plastic Surgery Kit
items.desc: A set of plastic surgery tools that Vee favors using in her work, containing masks and commonly-used medical apparatus. These tools make people beautiful, and they are the brush with which she signs her vision of "beauty". However, it looks nice even when it's just sitting by itself as a decoration.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Nanaka's Display Case
items.desc: A brilliantly shining idol, about to arrive in your home—lights, stage, music! Even the figures lined up in corners need to have the stage presence of a first-grade idol, Nanaka's star power is something every fan deserves to have! Nya♥~
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Sakuya's Garden Shears
items.desc: A sharp blade trims away unnecessary branches, displaying the flora in their most perfect form. ""South-pointing branches are allowable, fresh growths must be trimmed often."" These shears have been in Sakuya's hands for many years, and bear witness to how she toils. Of course, it works just as well against ill-intentioned people.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Lind's Gauntlet
items.desc: A wearable gauntlet created for Lind specifically. Its design radiates both a mechanical beauty and a sinister aura. Most importantly, it can create bursts of incredible power.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Imhotep's Headdress
items.desc: Imhotep's most commonly worn Egyptian-style head ornament, supposedly inspired by the goddess Bastet. It might not bestow the powers of animal speaking upon you, but your cuteness will go straight up.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Angela's Tome
items.desc: The magic tome that Angela, a mage from another world, always carries on her person. It contains hundreds of spells written in arcane texts that would prove extremely effective for anything from fighting dragons to warding knights. If you listen to Angela chant a passage from the tome late at night, you will probably get a good night's sleep.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Helix's Doll
items.desc: A doll of a little white mouse, modeled after Helix's pet. Soft to the touch and fluffy to boot. Accompanies Helix into sweet dreams every night. It is said that the Doll perfectly replicates its owner, Helix's whimpering-prone disposition. Perhaps that's why it is so widely loved at the Oasis.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: EG 4.0's blades
items.desc: Twin blades that came with the EG 4.0 model—Arvak and Alsvid. Named after two divine horses belonging to a sun goddess of northern European mythology. They have accompanied EG 4.0 in her battles for many years, and bore witness to the legendary warrior's hot-spirited feats.
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: PHK's Cleaning Tools
items.desc: A mop for home use that came with the PHK model. Simple to use, efficient in removing stains. When coffee, soup, or other "drinks" of unknown composition are spilt onto the floor, a little bit of water and a touch of this mop remove all traces. Simple, right?
items.source: Unlocked by Activating Multichannel Battle Pass

items.name: Christmas Tree
items.desc: In order to prove Santa Claus isn't just a legend, Antonina put a  capture program with a trigger in this Christmas tree. That is why this year's presents weren't hung up on it.

items.name: Electronic Display
items.desc: You're free to try and sleep and rise early or blast event PVs at max volume in the middle of the night. That's the benefit of living alone. In a kingdom populated only by yourself, you hold the ultimate power.

items.name: Quartz Display Stand
items.desc: Don't worry, nobody will mind that all the stones placed here were carefully picked. They only wish to be moved by the natural beauty here.

items.name: Firecracker Stall
items.desc: Filled with firecrackers provided by Octogen. Octogen guaranteed its stability through countless failures. That is also why he is not joining us for tonight's New Year Party.

items.name: Snow Boy
items.desc: The secret of a snowman's longevity lies in the fact that nobody plays with it during sustained harsh weather...quite the awkward fellow, isn't he?

items.name: Brazier
items.desc: A brazier used to keep warm and for people to step over it... Even though many Dolls don't understand why humans do it.

items.name: White Flower Harp
items.desc: I play songs of joy for others and forget my own life.

items.name: Decorative Bouquet
items.desc: People swear oaths on short-lived flowers so their witnesses won't rebuke them when they go back on their word. Humans are such sneaky creatures.

items.name: Wisteria Piano
items.desc: "I don't think anything would make me happier than being invited to play with you. If your mission is to make me happy, then please... Stop right here for me."

items.name: Hurricane Rollercoaster
items.desc:
A good rollercoaster will, while providing people with screams and heart-skipping thrill, make sure that the safety belts are sturdy. Otherwise? They'll become material for ghost stories.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Baah Stand
items.desc: The services provided here will instantly bring your mind back to the joyous summers of childhood, with sweat dripping down your backs. By the way, no lamb skewers are sold here.

items.name: Fairgrounds Egg-Lights
items.desc: The moths cling onto the star-like eggs, becoming mottled patches in the black night.

items.name: Cotton Candy Stall
items.desc: Cast sugar in one end, colorful clouds out the other. Truly a magic that only a cotton candy machine could hope to possess.

items.name: Popcorn Stall
items.desc: Don't worry, Evelyn, that's not the sound of a gun, it's just a popcorn machine! For real! Don't go around bashing stuff!

items.name: Event Ticket Stall
items.desc: Please enter after buying a pass here. You're saying someone with goat-like horns just went in without buying a pass? Nah, no way.

items.name: Bumper Car Courtyard
items.desc:
Turn, drift, collide, all in one smooth motion. Save for racing games and here, few other places will let you do so at your leisure.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Left Supplementary Light
items.desc: Those who like to post selfies on Instercam are more than aware of the importance of lighting when taking a photo of a human face, not to mention that this is professional equipment. Don't look into the bulb directly. Your fault if you do.

items.name: Right Supplementary Light
items.desc: Those who like to post selfies on Instercam are more than aware of the importance of lighting when taking a photo of a human face, not to mention that this is professional equipment. Have you prepared your luxurious snacks?

items.name: White Screen
items.desc: What do the staff responsible for post-processing hate most? To chip away all the background behind someone, of course. The screen solves this problem incredibly well.

items.name: Low Supplementary Light (Left)
items.desc: Fixing up lighting is not just a matter of turning on your extra lights, the angle is incredibly important too. The previous individual responsible for lighting who did not pay attention to this has already been buried six feet under by the post-processing crew.

items.name: Low Supplementary Light (Right)
items.desc: Fixing up lighting is not just a matter of turning on your extra lights, the angle is incredibly important too. The purpose of photography is to display beauty, and to waste one's own beauty is a crime!

items.name: Coat & Clothes Rack
items.desc: To turn oneself into a warrior, songstress, or demon king is not an uncommon fantasy for one to have when they are little. Some would see their dreams realized, some immerse themselves in a line of work weaving such beautiful dreams, and some forget their dreams, giving their all into the one and only reality.

items.name: Bar Champagne
items.desc: Civilization is merely an orderly flavor of profligacy. Blessings are no more than delicate and pleasant superstitions.

items.name: Ballroom Floor Lights
items.desc: Floor lights are far more selfless than even the candle. None look upon it, while it illuminates others.

items.name: Performance Stage
items.desc: To become a star arising from the darkness, or a seraphim standing grandiose in the light from the very beginning? Whatever you desire, of course. Now, let them observe, let them cheer!

items.name: CNC Robot Arm
items.desc: The pinnacle of CNC technology, it is said that it will never do any harm to anything it seizes, so we're currently using it to capture cats passing by, or sometimes Abigail.

items.name: Research Capsule
items.desc:
Despite the manufacturer warnings on the glass capsule of ""Do not sleep here"", some Dolls still clamber inside to rest. ""But there's aircon here!"" Ms. M, a Doll relevant to such an incident commented.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Unused Storage Crate
items.desc: Some things aren't used in daily life, but they're absolutely indispensable when they're needed. Throw an anti-dust cloth over it and it looks mysterious...

items.name: Storage Crate - Double Stack
items.desc: Some things aren't used in daily life, but they're absolutely indispensable when they're needed. Double the layers, double the awesome.

items.name: Storage Crate - Single Stack
items.desc: Some things aren't used in daily life, but they're absolutely indispensable when they're needed.

items.name: Power Cable Set
items.desc: Without power, all high-tech devices are nothing more than scrap. Such is the strength and weakness of modern society.

items.name: Administrator's Control Terminal
items.desc: When you consider the fact that this terminal is the brain of the entire control center, it makes sense that it's been designed to be able to continue functioning for a while without power. Nobody knows when such an accident will occur, but it's better to be prepared than not.

items.name: Core Control Terminal
items.desc: Some people feel that touchscreens replacing keyboards is a sign of progress, but many others believe that typing on keys feels more real to them. Thus, this control panel simultaneously reflects the views of both camps.

items.name: UV Disinfecting Lamp
items.desc: As everyone knows, Dolls don't need to worry about skin care. But if it's you, Professor, it might be best if you didn't stand too long in front of this UV lamp.

items.name: Processing Terminal
items.desc:
"This is not a juice squeezer!"
After a few small incidents, someone has stuck a little handwritten note next to the control interface and drawn a frowny face on it.

items.name: Cheerleader Robots
items.desc: An agent of the Helios Sector. It once lost ten matches in a row while extraordinarily angry, and is now working to pay off debt. Cheers on every player currently in that very state of rage.

items.name: Pacbaa
items.desc: The great Baalia descends upon the Arcade, and chooses you as her partner-in-crime. Come, guide her as she eats every single... wait! Don't go! This costs like nothing to play!

items.name: Gachapon Machine
items.desc: Round pieces of dreams hidden within, one for each coin.

items.name: Dance Machine
items.desc:
The pressure of countless eyes and your own timidity were once great obstacles. Now you have surmounted mountains and oceans to stride upon this little stage. Come, King! Time to dance!
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Baalia Punch Machine
items.desc:
Display your power! See just how far this despicable Memeko can fly!
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Rhythm Master
items.desc:
Follow the rhythm and try to hit every single beat! Not everywhere can you fulfil the dream of performing along with the composer.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Cat-Headed Pumpkins
items.desc: The mysterious felines love to explore everything. Even if they were to be turned into pumpkins, they still wish for you to take them along. It's not like they can die again, after all.

items.name: Castle Storage Rack
items.desc: The first scroll upon this rack says: To leave alive, please open the third scroll from the left on the second row, and leave the others untouched. Hello again, then, soon-to-be pumpkin explorer.

items.name: Knight's Armor
items.desc: The knight watches over this castle, for the honor of deceased masters.

items.name: Secret Kingdom
items.desc: Once I close the flap, only you and I are left in the world. I've already found the things which people spend their whole lives searching for: security, safety and the peace of mind you give me.

items.name: Dynamic Snapshot
items.desc:
The best part of a home movie theater is that we can see whatever we want and end it wherever we choose.
"Getting a happy ending depends on when you consider the story over."

items.name: Warm Buds
items.desc:
I don't know if plants rejoice at our laughter, but I bet they don't like noise.
"Or maybe they like it loud!"

items.name: Crystal Reindeer
items.desc: The book of fairytales under the pillow talks about how we'll dash through the snow and dance with the reindeer.

items.name: Iceman
items.desc: If a snowman knocks on the door, make sure to invite him in. People are always trying to get out of the snow and it gets lonely too.

items.name: Star Light
items.desc: When we embrace, the light that leaks in through our eyelids is a candlelight at night, the light of the stars in winter.

items.name: Big Christmas Tree
items.desc: When we look at each other, we look at each other's feelings, hung up high.

items.name: Present Pile
items.desc: The presents we see when we look around are filled with the longing of family and friends.

items.name: Gold-Leaved Bonsai
items.desc: Supposedly, Kuro managed to shake a copper coin out of the Fortune Tree before. While nobody knows who put it there, this bonsai has been plagued by people trying to shake it ever since.

items.name: Candied Hawthorn Stall
items.desc:
Myriad surprises are hidden inside the crystal-like rock candy. From youth to adulthood, there are bound to be sweet memories with a bit of sour in them. Millau's made a move! Something she hasn't eaten before!
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Pyrotechnic Pile
items.desc: This represents the loudest blessing of the New Year, as guaranteed by Octogen. Truly, the fact that he didn't get himself sent to the Medical Department while testing out these firecrackers is a blessing indeed.

items.name: Destroyed Energy Canister
items.desc: Traces of combustible fuel are vaguely visible inside this damaged canister, and it conjures up images of ancient batteries. It looks dangerous, but it does not seem like a priority issue— Chelsea's already taken care of it.

items.name: Ruined Planter
items.desc: This is a destroyed planter, but the remaining greenery on it still seems to be thriving. If you can spend enough time on it, it'll surely flourish with life once again.

items.name: Detection Device
items.desc: One of the few devices which hasn't been destroyed, it continues running even now. Although it emits the odd burst of static every now and then, nobody complains about it, because they need it to find many friends whose signals are unclear.

items.name: Rest Stop
items.desc:
One of a few pieces of equipment not destroyed. The relevant systems have long stopped working, but the blissful memories of them will not fade. Before the next car gets here, let us wait in silence.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Floor-To-Ceiling Display
items.desc: This big display board reports the latest directions and news. When it malfunctions, it fills with cute emojis, invisibly easing the tension in the air.

items.name: Abandoned Materials
items.desc: Construction Debris which hasn't been fully cleared yet. It's been piled up for later disposal. Jessie will arrive soon with her cleaning implements, so please leave the task of stacking it up to professionals.

items.name: Public Greenery
items.desc:
An undamaged and whole greenified zone, still bursting with vitality. Can be brought as long as a exemplar when repairing other greenified zones, and adjustments can be made with Sakuya's guidance. Even with limited Operands, she can always conceive something beautiful and classy.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Warning Road Sign
items.desc: A road sign that indicates that repair works are going on ahead. Modified from a signpost, it delivers a short, clear message. The aesthetics can be left for when there's more free time!

items.name: Access Forbidden
items.desc: A cordon that indicates the area up ahead is dangerous. Very noticeable at night. No physical roadblock can beat a simulated roadblock— the penalties for breaking the law during special circumstances are more severe than usual.

items.name: Emergency Supplies
items.desc: Packed supply crates filled with various essential supplies and equipment. Some of them actually contain non-essential items because the supervisor gathered them, packed them, and then couldn't bring themselves to throw them away after realizing their mistake.

items.name: Jellyfish Nightlight
items.desc: It resembles a bunny, gleams with faint radiance and feels very soft and fluffy. As for the species that it was modelled after, the Dolls have tried calling it by many names, but they haven't gotten an answer yet.

items.name: Tide Caller's Staff
items.desc: "Come forth, O surf. Our dance celebrates death and praises destruction."

items.name: Distant Ocean Helmet
items.desc: A cute and mysterious helmet. Putting it on makes you feel like you've sunk underwater, riding the ocean currents, drifting toward a distant little dream. Huh, so the dream's not little anymore?

items.name: Hanging Contemplation
items.desc: Before you sleep, it isn't just this light that comes on, but the boundless expanse of your thoughts. Perhaps there are many things you still can't figure out, but that's alright; you can explore them all while veiled in this gentle radiance and slowly sink into slumber.

items.name: Fragments of Thought
items.desc: Your dreams and memories change on their own because of your longings. The bad can be forgiven, and the good becomes brighter and more attractive, encouraging you to relive them.

items.name: Remnants of Sleepiness
items.desc: It takes great courage to rouse yourself from your scattered thoughts or from a long dream. Until everything falls into place, why not cling to this pile of pillows and give yourself a lingering embrace?

items.name: Advertising Billboard
items.desc: "Ah Sir, fighting movies aren't popular any more. Young people nowadays like cyberpunk with a hint of romance to it, sci-fi shows with some military elements... yes, yes, yes, that's what the billboard is showing."

items.name: Ring Toss Stall
items.desc: "Step right up, step right up, take home anything you manage to ring; I run an honest game and I tell no lies— Ah, that's the stall owner; you don't get to take the stall owner home!"

items.name: Night Market Clothier's
items.desc:
With the assistance of colored lights, even the most commonplace attire can appear fabulous. For clothes, though, the most important thing 
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>is comfort.

items.name: Bull Market
items.desc: Every age has its trends, and the realization and shattering of dreams play out here as well.

items.name: Roadside Restaurant
items.desc:
With the temptation of bundle discounts, it's easy to buy way too much cheap food. If you have a massive gathering of friends, though, there's no need to worry about that.
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Mobile Freezer
items.desc:
""Want some milk tea? Add as much ice as you want to keep it cool. Ah! You, there, Miss, no parkouring on top of the car—""
<color=#bebebe> [Provides 1 extra living space] </color>

items.name: Egg Waffle Stall
items.desc: "We have many flavors for you to choose from, and our food goes well with that drink stall over there. Eat up quickly, sir; an egg waffle is like love; it's no good once it cools off..."

items.name: Night Market Round Table
items.desc: When there are many people around, exactly how many chairs can fit around one such table is a mystery. For the night market, you've got to pack in as many people as possible to make things lively!

items.name: Space Suit Rack
items.desc: After finishing an extra-vehicular activity, you can hang your space suit on its specialized fixed hanger. Putting on a heavy spacesuit on under normal gravity conditions is actually quite strenuous.

items.name: Space Greenery
items.desc: Although space stations have their own atmosphere processing equipment and don't need the additional help from flora—the occasional space plant is valuable in its own right. Even if its just a pair of leaves that open up under the light, they give the people around them a reassuring presence of life.

items.name: Observation Equipment
items.desc: This is the most expensive part of the room, composed of complex instrumentation and multiple screens filled with densely-packed technical readouts. During the endless days spent in its company, aimless ruminations are less worrying than the never-ending stream of problems that keep cropping up.

items.name: Planetarium Projector
items.desc: This conscientious holographic projector reproduces the environs of space to the point where the line between fiction and reality is no longer distinct. Here you can sail through the stars without protection, like a dream made flesh.

items.name: Projection of Jupiter
items.desc: The largest planet in the solar system, with an eye of storms fixed firmly on the Earth. When you gaze at it, it too gazes silently at you.

items.name: Projection of Saturn
items.desc: Dust, debris and satellites enfold it in the form of gleaming orbital rings. This uniqueness is what allows it to seize the attention of stargazers.

items.name: Projection of Uranus
items.desc: Covered in coldest ice, named after the King of the Gods. Could there be a blazing ocean hidden beneath its cold blue glow?

items.name: Unknown Star System
items.desc: Unknown worlds and unknown stats are part of the surprise awaiting you on a stellar trek. The desire for knowledge guides your steps toward exploration; and there is still a long way for your voyage to go.

items.name: Gaze of Alpacaman
items.desc: The screen is supposed to display a game where you interact with an Alpaca with the included microphone. But when the alpaca turns its unblinking, unmoving gaze upon you, you can't help but feel that something is wrong...

items.name: Future Gadget No. 99
items.desc: Its proper designation is Future Gadget No. 99 version 3.1415926... However, we're still debating over its official name. While it's still a Future Gadget under testing, it has become an important symbol that links both worlds.

items.name: IBN 5100
items.desc: Is... is this the IBN 5100?! Well done, Magrasea... To think you could recreate even a legendary PC like this... If Shining Finger were here, I bet she'd be drooling over it by now.

items.name: Lodestar's Seat
items.desc: The greatest throne appears in the dawn, displaying holy radiance for all to see, hiding the lure of corruption beneath.

items.name: Hanging Stones
items.desc: A strangeness beyond conventional comprehension, displayed in the form of floating stones and lights. Perhaps, someone once sat upon it, playing like a child.

items.name: Apparatus of Divine Summons
items.desc: Feel the calling of those above in these bright and clear spaces. Though you can use this thing as a gaming monitor too.

items.name: Pillar of the Heavens
items.desc: Great and exquisite, a pillar to the heavens supporting a vast temple. Not unlike that familiar figure that appears in one's mind.

items.desc: Even without this picture, that day's scenery and that person's face has long since been engraved into your heart.
items.source: Obtained from the event "Heartfelt House of Cocoa".

items.desc: A still frame from "Quenching Operation". The logistics department took a screenshot of the most iconic scene from this event and turned it into a painting as a memento.

items.name: Painting - Livestreaming
items.desc: A still frame from one of Kuro's livestreams. The logistics department took a screenshot of the most iconic scene from this event and turned it into a painting as a memento.

items.name: Painting - Magrasea's Lang Syne
items.desc: The New Year is a festive occasion, and this is one of the pictures taken in Oasis during that time. This picture best represents the New Year, so the logistics department made it into a painting as a memento.
items.source: Obtained from the event "Magrasea's Lang Syne".

items.name: Painting - Midnight Machinations
items.desc: This is a film with special significance. The logistics department took a screenshot of the most entertaining scene from this event and turned it into a painting as a memento.

items.name: Painting - Eager Fist, Dawning Fray
items.desc: A still image from the Wishing Fist tournament video records. The logistics department took a screenshot of the most moving scene from this event and turned it into a painting as a memento.
items.source: Obtained from the event "Eager Fist, Dawning Fray".

items.name: Painting - Chromatic Spiral
items.desc: After joining the Oasis' Medical Department, she took this picture with a heart full of gratitude and anxiety. In light of Helix's outstanding performance after that, the logistics department turned it into a painting as a memento.

items.name: Painting - Ruintop Song
items.desc: A still frame from the video log of Zangyin's adventure in Cyclopes. The logistics department took a screenshot of the most exciting scene from it and turned it into a painting as a memento.

items.name: Painting - Gastronomic Journey
items.desc: This picture comes from Millau's gourmet food column, taken by her best friend. It's been widely praised due to the moving expression on her face. After arriving in the Oasis the logistics department turned it into a painting as a memento.

items.name: Painting - Divergent Shadows
items.desc: An illustration of an important part of a story told by a certain Professor who wished to remain anonymous. The Logistics Department synthesized this image according to the descriptions given, and created a piece of furniture as a memoir.

items.name: Painting - Twilight Requiem
items.desc: Perilous moments experienced by Clotho and Centaureissi in the Austen Military Zone. The Logistics Department synthesized this image according to the descriptions given by Clotho, and created a piece of furniture as a memoir.

items.name: Wall Hanging - L.A.D. Riddle
items.desc: A still frame from Dupin's and Aki's adventures in taking back a prized sword in Japan. The logistics department rendered Dupin's narration in picture form and turned it into a wall hanging as a memento.

items.name: Painting – Symphonic Reprise
items.desc: A critical moment when Undine and her aides were fleeing the Doll reclamation plant. The logistics department rendered Undine's narration into picture form and turned it into a painting as a memento.

items.name: Painting – Joyful Reunion
items.desc: A moving scene of Jiangyu and Daiyan's reunion. The logistics department rendered Rise's footage into picture form and turned it into a painting as a memento.

items.name: Painting – Divining the Heart
items.desc: This is a scene of a revelatory moment when Yelena picked up her tarot cards. The logistics department rendered Yelena's narration into picture form and turned it into a painting as a memento.

items.name: Painting – Cleansing Aria
items.desc: A scene of Erika helping Dushevnaya through a tough time with her evil-cleansing implements in hand. The logistics department rendered Yelena's narration into picture form and turned it into a Painting as a memento.

items.name: Painting - Crisis Rescue
items.desc: A scene of Cascadia holding up a massive chunk of debris by herself during a rescue attempt in order to keep her rescue target from getting hurt. The Security Department has turned this moment into a piece of furniture to commemorate the occasion.

items.name: Painting – Oneiric Odyssey
items.desc: This records the moment when Taisch was brought out of the lonely aquarium filled with dreams and heartache. As per your instructions, the Logistics Department has captured this moment into a still image and turned it into a piece of furniture as a memento.
